2608.03118.title: From SQL Errors to Concept Gaps: An AI-Powered Knowledge Graph Analytics Platform for Personalized Feedback
2608.03118.paper_summary: This innovative practice full paper describes an AI-powered knowledge graph platform that connects SQL errors to conceptual gaps in undergraduate and graduate database systems courses. Students learning Structured Query Language (SQL) frequently struggle with semantic errors that reflect conceptual misunderstandings rather than syntax mistakes. A query may execute yet return incorrect results due to gaps spanning related concepts; misusing NATURAL JOIN in place of an explicit subquery reflects intertwined misunderstandings of JOIN, GROUP BY, and HAVING. Autograding systems detect correctness but provide surface-level feedback without connecting errors to the conceptual structure of the course. Educational knowledge graph research has shown the value of structured concept representations for curriculum analysis and adaptive learning, but these approaches have not been applied to diagnosing SQL misconceptions from student submissions. We present a platform that automatically extracts course concepts and relations from instructional materials, links them to student submission traces through a graph database, and classifies errors at the concept level. We evaluate the platform across two database systems courses at two universities, one using real student submissions and one using simulated submissions, through an expert study with five participants and an automated evaluation using an LLM as a judge. Results show that 95.7% of extracted nodes were rated as at least somewhat valid and 63.8% of triplets were rated fully correct. Expert feedback confirmed that the generated graphs align with instructor mental models and that mapping errors to course concepts provides actionable diagnostic insight; evaluating impact on student learning remains future work.
2608.03118.paper_summary_zh: 這篇創新的實踐完整論文描述了一個由人工智慧驅動的知識圖譜平台，該平台將 SQL 錯誤與本科生和研究生數據庫系統課程中的概念缺口相連接。學習結構化查詢語言（SQL）的學生經常面臨語義錯誤，這些錯誤反映了概念上的誤解，而非語法錯誤。查詢可能執行但返回不正確的結果，這是由於相關概念之間的缺口；將 NATURAL JOIN 錯誤地用作明確的子查詢反映了對 JOIN、GROUP BY 和 HAVING 的錯誤理解。自動評分系統檢測正確性，但提供的反饋僅限於表面層面，未能將錯誤與課程的概念結構相連接。教育知識圖譜研究已顯示結構化概念表示在課程分析和自適應學習中的價值，但這些方法尚未應用於診斷學生提交中的 SQL 誤解。我們提出了一個平台，該平台自動從教學材料中提取課程概念和關係，通過圖形數據庫將它們與學生提交的痕跡相連接，並在概念層面上對錯誤進行分類。我們在兩所大學的兩門數據庫系統課程中評估該平台，一門使用真實學生提交，另一門使用模擬提交，通過五位參與者的專家研究和使用 LLM 作為評判的自動評估。結果顯示，95.7% 的提取節點被評為至少有些有效，63.8% 的三元組被評為完全正確。專家反饋確認生成的圖與講師的心理模型一致，並且將錯誤映射到課程概念提供了可行的診斷見解；評估對學生學習的影響仍然是未來的工作。
